findings.title: DebuggedApplication evalex command execution is gated by secret and pin trust
SharedDataMiddleware directory loader uses safe_join to block traversal
safe_join fails to reject Windows UNC/leading-double-slash paths, allowing base-directory escape on Windows with Python < 3.11
send_from_directory _root_path join does not permit base-directory escape
secure_filename strips separators and non-ASCII, preventing traversal in stored filenames
Debug get_resource, shared_data middleware, and FileStorage.save introduce no independent traversal beyond safe_join's platform caveat
DebuggedApplication evalex console/execute endpoints are gated by PIN and host trust (no bypass found)
safe_join path containment is robust in Werkzeug 3.0.6 (Windows UNC fix present)
send_file/send_from_directory path construction is contained; no traversal from client path
SharedDataMiddleware path handling is contained via safe_join
Debugger get_resource path traversal neutralized by basename()
FileStorage.filename is client-controlled but save() destination is caller-supplied; no library traversal
